Perfect! I've added the `Invoice.units()` method to the Invoice class. The method sums the `qty` field across all line items, following the same pattern as the existing `subtotal()` method.

**All tests pass** ✓ (10/10 passing)

The implementation is straightforward:
```python
def units(self):
    return sum(item.qty for item in self.items)
```

This method will return the total quantity across all line items in an invoice. For example, if an invoice has line items with quantities 2 and 1, `units()` will return 3.
